query:
SELECT
            a.id as "id?",
            COALESCE(a.full_name, a.label, i.full_name) AS "full_name?",
            r.label AS "room_name?",
            r.id AS "room_id?",
            agm.role as "role: GroupRole"
        FROM
            accounts_people a
            FULL JOIN identities i ON i.id = a.auth_id
            LEFT JOIN res_leases l ON a.id = l.tenant_id
            LEFT JOIN res_rooms r ON l.room_id = r.id JOIN account_group_memberships agm ON a.id = agm.account_id WHERE agm.group_id = $1  ORDER BY (a.id IS NULL) DESC, (i.id IS NULL) DESC, r.label DESC LIMIT $2 OFFSET $3
